_comment: Optional starter constraint pack. OFF by default — install with `scripts/install.sh --with-constraints`, or load later via `python3 world_model.py` + these rows. Each is a low-normative-confidence prior; validate or delete per your project. Deliberately tiny and generic.

constraints.name: no-eval-of-external-input
constraints.message_tmpl: {subject} {predicate} {object} — dynamic eval/exec is a common injection sink; confirm input is trusted

constraints.name: single-owner-per-table
constraints.message_tmpl: {subject} has multiple owners: {values} — ownership should be singular
